rationale: ROOT CAUSE ACROSS ALL THREE REVIEW ROUNDS, recorded as required. The defects found in revisions 1 and 2 were not defects of the measurements or of the evidence logic; they were defects of process documentation that had never been mechanically checked against the real toolchain. Round 1: the compiler-generated RUNBOOK mandates a post-run analysis step whose metric whitelist unconditionally rejects the metric the request declared, so the documented flow could not complete (v2_analysis.py:276); the recomputation harness had no entry point and lay outside the reviewed hash set; its reports were truncated. Round 2: the same class again - the procedure named superseded experiment directories, and because run-remote.sh:97 derives the run id from the config filename, following it would have executed the wrong revision and attributed the runs to it, while the procedure documented no finalization or authorization step at all even though run-remote.sh:82 refuses to start without one. In every case a human-readable instruction was treated as if it were executable, and nothing mechanically compared the prose to the tools it invokes. Revision 3 therefore does not just correct individual sentences: it derives every run command from the revision own experiment ids and adds a mechanical check that no run command can reference an earlier revision, and it documents the authorization chain with the exact commands and expected sentinels. The residual risk is recorded rather than hidden: the check is a documented, reproducible one-liner rather than a committed gate inside the pipeline, so the durable fix is to make procedure executability a mechanical gate before any formal run. REVIEWER PROVENANCE, recorded verbatim as required. Revision 1 cold_start review was performed by a Codex cold-start session, a different model family from the executing agent, and returned BLOCK. Revisions 2 and 3 were reviewed by independent cold-start sessions on z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (Zhipu GLM family) for cold_start and adversarial, and meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor (Meta Muse family) for satellite_drl. AGENTS.md rule 20 requires different-model cold-start review OR Codex independent cold-start self-review; two non-DeepSeek families satisfy the different-model branch. Codex became unavailable because its quota was exhausted, so these rounds substituted GLM/Muse and did NOT wait for the quota to recover. Reviewer independence is evidenced by the reviewers own work rather than by attestation: the satellite_drl reviewer re-hashed all 17 bound artifacts itself, independently recomputed the corridor profile equivalence (load_config_file(profile) == d45c6a50580958c3d14bc7ff576cb36f0f57c91953e12c8c80478842277fd27f) and independently inspected the denominator fallback at CODE/leo_sim/metrics.py:334-340; the cold_start reviewer independently ran the harness selftest and re-verified the paired-design signatures; the adversarial reviewer was a fresh cold-start session on the final bytes. MECHANICAL SELF-CHECK, reproducible. Command: grep -n "EXPERIMENTS/EXP-20260923-T1-STEP5-[A-Z]*-R0[12]" R03/PROCEDURE.md . Expected sentinel: no match, grep exits 1, so a shell && / || chain prints the clean sentinel. Actual output: no match, sentinel none (clean). Companion check: the four run commands extracted from PROCEDURE.md are set-equal to the four run_id values in the two R03 run-manifest.json files; both were re-run at decision time and both hold. This check is a documented, reproducible one-liner, NOT a committed pipeline gate, and that limitation is stated rather than glossed. UNFIXED PROCESS DEFECT REGISTERED, deliberately not repaired in this batch: the compiler-generated RUNBOOK mandates v2_analysis while v2_analysis._metric_from_result (CODE/experiment_platform/v2_analysis.py:276) rejects any metric outside its whitelist. This batch works around it by declaring the supported metric e2e_delay_mean_s; editing v2_analysis or widening its whitelist would be a production-contract change outside this batch authorisation, and was not done. All five blocking findings from rounds 1 and 2 are preserved verbatim in R01/decision.json and R02/decision.json rather than folded away.
